h: Move the reply ladder onto accounts 5 to 50 times your size
t: Replies averaged 48.3 views against 150.4 for originals.
p: A reply only reaches your followers plus that thread's readers.
Reply inside the first 30 to 60 minutes.
Target 20 to 30 substantive replies a day.
s: Algo basis: the out of network reply filter, xai-org/x-algorithm. Influencer basis: published reply ladder playbooks.

h: Give every post something worth saving
t: 1 repost and 4 bookmarks across 16 posts and 1,933 views.
p: A repost is the only free route out of your own network.
Saveable means a number, a list or a template.
s: Algo basis: repost and bookmark are separately predicted actions. Influencer basis: bookmarks as a first class quality signal.

h: Raise the floor on views per post
t: Median 90.5 views, and 8 of 16 posts came in under 100.
p: Space posts at least 2 hours apart so author diversity decay resets.
Publish 3 to 5 times a day, every day, not in bursts.
s: Algo basis: author diversity decay. Influencer basis: published cadence guidance.
